What is our primary use case?

My main use case for UiPath Platform includes multiple use cases. My experience is mostly on mainframes, Excel, web automation, agentic automation using Maestro, and some parts of SAP, ServiceNow, and API integrations as well.

One specific example of a use case I worked on with UiPath Platform is agentic automation, which we have gone live with recently. As Volvo is a logistic company mainly involved in manufacturing trucks and buses, we usually receive multiple orders to deliver to different vendors. After delivering the parts, sometimes we deliver defective parts or some parts get missed, causing vendors to raise discrepancies via email by attaching photos or describing in the mail body any parts that are missing. We get these discrepancies in our ERP system with all the details, and we extract everything to pass it to our agent, who analyzes the correctness of the discrepancy. If it is correct, it is approved; if not, it is rejected. If the agent cannot identify anything, it passes to human validation where a human will provide approval or rejection, affecting how the discrepancy is handled in the ERP.

My team has utilized UiPath Academy courses, which have been hugely beneficial. Through various workshops on AI and Maestro, we have gained a thorough understanding of how agents work and how effective the Maestro system is.

I actively use agentic automation in UiPath Platform and have employed an image analysis agent that assesses if delivered products are defective by examining the images and their accompanying emails. Although it works effectively, there are still some improvements needed to enhance reliability, especially due to the current limitations around confidence scores.

The best feature I have observed in UiPath Platform is Data Services, as it significantly improved our handling of data compared to the previous Excel-based process. Monitoring Excel was often a hectic resolution, requiring use of SharePoint to facilitate access for multiple people, which led to file corruption issues. With the Data Fabric feature, we can manage and sort data effectively and fix everything smoothly.

are around investment type data, where we normally work with business units needing to pull in data where an API is not readily available.

We have not started testing use cases as we are governed heavily by compliance, and we have what's called an RAIC council, so anything involving AI or LLMs has to go through them. We submit an intake form and wait for approval before we can start working on it.

That being said, we have two potential use cases that we've already submitted the request to start testing out agents and AI within some workflows. I can share some details about those use cases, which are really centered around extracting data from very unstructured documents, as the structures frequently change quarter over quarter, making it quite complicated.
How has it helped my organization?

I have realized benefits utilizing UiPath Platform, and specifically, this year alone from January until last week, we have saved about $650,000 for the firm, with close to 5,000 hours saved by diving deeper into pulling investment data.
